content: Ekken gelen aazize
Ta ishuntso, taanii higge erize asuntsis ohine. Higge fettii asi faxa yeze wode eza ahizanno eroso?
Aazizes, azinii gelide maachita I azinze faxa yeze wode higgera ezara acinttida. Yezin I azinze hyayqiko ezara iza caaqide caaqita izo ahoos.
Yinnii gisho, iza fa azinze faxa yezin, melle dhiiratsi geliko, iza laammida ga7inttane. Yezin I azinze hyayqiko, caaqo izo ahoosse gisho iza melle azinii geliko, iza olalida ga7inttoos.
Yinnii gisho, ta ishuntso, yin Kiristtoosa asho baggara higge wolqqas hyayqqii, Xoozis aafe aafodes hyayqoppa denddide Kiristtoosas maaqqida.
Nu asho amo nuna ahin, nu yeze wode higge gujjii nagara oochchode gaar nuna dentsitsane. Nu ashtii gidda iita amotitsi yeze gisho nuunii hyayqo aafe aafode fana oochchane yeshsha.
Yezin hyatte nuunii nuna accide higgitis hyayqide gisho nuunii higge achchappa bilnttida. Yinnii gisho, kille Ayyaanar Xoozis kiitinttanep attin xaafinttide gal77a higgitis kiitinttoos.
Higgen nagaran
Yeezin, nuunii waagawude? Higge nagarane? Ade! Yezin higge nagara akko yezako tana erssida. Higge, «Amudhdhippe» gaykaayzako, amudhdhe akko yezako ta eroos.
Yezin ta ubba baz amudhdhode fana nagara higge baggara ta gidda oge denggida. Higge baayzako nagara hyayqqide baz.
Zaga higge baayze wode ta faxa, yezin higge ingginttide wode nagara faxin ta hyayqqida.
Taanii de7o yessade fana Xoozii inggide higge taas hyayqo ki7ida.
Nagara higge baggara tana cimmize oge denggi, wodhida.
Yinnii gisho, higge geeshi; ize xaafinttide kiittan geeshi, xillon lo77o.

Yeezin, lo77o maaqqide baz taalla afa hyayqo ki7idaane? Ade! Yezin nagara nagara maaqqizanna qonccode fana lo77o bazara maaddinttii taas hyayqo ki7ida. Yinnii gisho, nagara nagara maaqqidanna higge baggara aadhii erinttida.
Nuunii higge ayyaanabaz maaqqizanno erane. Yezin taanii nagaras bayzinttide asho asi.
Taanii ta oochchizanno tiiroos; taanii kadhizebaz oochchodanno ashshii ta ixxizebaz oochchane.
Taanii ixxizebaz oochchizebaz maaqqiko, higge lo77o maaqqizanno ta markkidhane.
Yinno maaqqiko, yinna oochito ta gidda yeze nagartta oochchanep attin ta oochchoos.
Ta gidda, yinnan ta ashite lo77o baz baazanno erane. Lo77o baz oochchize amotitsi ta gidda yene, yezin lo77o baz oochchodes dandda7oos.
Taanii ixxize iita baz oochchanep attin ta kadhize lo77o baz oochchoos.
Taanii ixxizebaz oochchizebaz maaqqiko, yinna ta gidda yeze nagartta oochchanep attin oochchize tana baaya.
Yikke, ta lo77o baz oochchodes kadhizin, iita baz oochchizanno beezize higge denggida.
Taanii ta wozintte Xoozze wogite ufayttane.
Yezin ta asatitsite yezay ta guugite yeze higgera olinttize dumma higge be7ine. Ye higgize ta asatitsite oochchize nagara higges tana aro mahi inggida.
Taanii wayzi alla wodhdhide aso? Hyayqos kanggize hyanna asatitsitippa tana ashshode oode?
Nu Laatstse Yesuus Kiristtoosa baggara tana ashshize Xoozzes galata maaqqe. Yikke, taanii ta qofite Xoozze higges aqane; yezin ta asatitsite nagara higges aqane.
